question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A', 'B' and 'C' to write five complete sentences.

guide_solution: (a) We should say 'No' to corruption because it is a social crime and obstructs the development of society. (b) If we want to cope with the development of the world, we should unitedly stand against corruption. (c) In order to control corruption, we should work together and raise awareness among the people. (d) But we are so self-centered that we do not think of the welfare of our country. (e) People who are corrupted are not only dishonest but also harmful in our society.
